title: Marcos leads PESO congress in Cebu, launches new employment programs

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday led the opening of the 26th National Public Employment Service Office (PESO) Congress, where the government launched new employment programs aimed at helping disadvantaged workers and improving access to livelihood opportunities.
